# Send Message

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Sends a message to a recipient.

## Syntax

~~~~text
sendMessage(message: <#String (Allows Variables)#>, recipient: <#Variable#>, show: <#Boolean (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
sendMessage(message: "Hello!", recipient: Recipient, show: false)
~~~~
